meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会调用 gtars 的 Python 接口或命令行，来处理基因组区间：找重叠、生成覆盖率文件、把区域转成机器学习 token，还能处理参考序列和片段。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BED 文件、检测区间重叠、生成覆盖率轨道等基因组任务，特别是用于机器学习或单细胞片段分析时，Claude 会启用 gtars。

say.text: 用 gtars 找出这两个 BED 文件的重叠区间。
say.note: Claude 会构建 IGD 索引并输出重叠区域。

say.text: 把 fragments.bed 转成 BigWig 覆盖率轨道。
say.note: Claude 会运行 uniwig 生成覆盖率文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the gtars Python API or CLI to process genomic intervals: find overlaps, generate coverage files, tokenize regions for ML, and handle reference sequences and fragments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to process BED intervals, detect overlaps, generate coverage tracks (WIG/BigWig), or perform ML preprocessing/tokenization and single-cell fragment analysis.

say_en.text: Use gtars to find overlaps between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Claude outputs overlapping regions via IGD index.

say_en.text: Convert fragments.bed to a BigWig coverage track.
say_en.note: Claude runs uniwig to generate the coverage file.
